rows.grounds: verb expressing ascertainment or decisive determination
object of determination; compound of śāstra and artha
demonstrative pronoun referring to the qualified person
object of knowing; righteous duty or law
negated alternative; na fused with itaraḥ

items.question: Who alone possesses authoritative knowledge of dharma through scriptural interpretation?
premises: A qualified person determines the meaning of scripture.
items.inference: Only the one who correctly determines scriptural meaning truly knows dharma.
items.plain_english: And he who determines the meaning of the scripture knows dharma, not another.
